layer: device endpoint, plain frames above the security layer (protocol_spec.md 16.1)
rules: time advances event by event; at an instant: timers due before it, then the input, then timers due at it
every random draw uniform(a, b) takes (a + b) / 2
actions: per ACTION 'time' (s, default 0) and 'result' (default OK); 'run' is logged when the action starts, its result counts once 'time' is over
'pending': the action returns PENDING (run result -1), 'time' is its deadline; a 'complete' step calls Device.complete and logs whether it was taken
expect lists every sent frame ('tx') and every action run ('run'), in order

cases.name: request_runs_once_and_answers
cases.description: A fast action runs at once and its result is the answer.

cases.name: retry_replays_the_original_result
cases.description: A retry is answered with the stored result (ERROR stays ERROR) and does not run again.

cases.name: window_pushes_out_the_oldest_closed_record
cases.description: dedup_window closed records per sender: the oldest is pushed out, its late copy runs again.

cases.name: senders_are_kept_least_recently_used
cases.description: max_senders lists; a new sender pushes out the least recently used one.

cases.name: a_retry_keeps_its_sender
cases.description: A retry counts as hearing from its sender: a third sender pushes out the other one, the retry after it is answered from the record.

cases.name: a_query_keeps_its_sender
cases.description: A query counts as hearing from its sender too: the third sender pushes out the other one.

cases.name: records_expire_after_the_keep_period
cases.description: Past dedup_ttl a record is forgotten: a copy arriving later runs again.

cases.name: query_answers_the_stored_result
cases.description: A status query (ACTION 0xFF, VALUE = asked SEQUENCE) gets the stored result and runs nothing.

cases.name: query_of_an_unknown_request_makes_not_run_final
cases.description: An unknown request is answered NOT_RUN and recorded so: a late copy is refused, not run.

cases.name: frames_for_others_and_broadcast_requests_are_ignored
cases.description: A REQUEST to another node or to broadcast, and an undecodable frame, get no answer.

cases.name: sleeping_device_defers_frames_and_wakes
cases.description: Asleep, a frame is handled after sleep_delay (midpoint 2 s); WAKE switches to READY.

cases.name: sleep_queue_drops_repeats_and_overflow
cases.description: A copy of a waiting frame adds nothing; past max_deferred frames are dropped.

cases.name: heartbeats_follow_the_interval
cases.description: First heartbeat at the midpoint of (0.2, interval), then every interval; it carries the state.

cases.name: slow_action_accepts_then_reports
cases.description: Past answer_budget: ACCEPTED at once, RESULT when done, repeated until acknowledged.

cases.name: unacknowledged_result_backs_off_then_stops
cases.description: RESULT again after result_timeout × 2^n, result_retries more times, then left to queries.

cases.name: query_while_running_then_after
cases.description: A query meets the running action: ACCEPTED. Once over, the query gets the result and stops the RESULT repeats.

cases.name: short_action_answer_waits_for_the_result
cases.description: Within answer_budget the answer is sent when the action is over and carries the result; no RESULT.

cases.name: retry_during_short_action_hears_accepted_then_result
cases.description: A retry while the short action runs is answered ACCEPTED, so a RESULT follows (review A6).

cases.name: open_records_past_max_open_are_refused
cases.description: Past max_open open records a slow request is refused NOT_RUN, finally (a late copy too).

cases.name: reboot_keeps_records_and_ends_a_cut_action_interrupted
cases.description: Records survive a reboot: a retry is not run. An action cut short is INTERRUPTED (no final result; it may have completed; wire v5), not ERROR; the retry gets INTERRUPTED and closes the record, so no RESULT follows (STATUS P4; one not asked about sends its RESULT after boot, next case).

cases.name: reboot_cuts_a_short_action_and_the_retry_gets_interrupted
cases.description: A reboot while a short action (within the budget) runs: its answer was not sent; the retry gets INTERRUPTED, not ERROR and not OK, and is not run again (wire v5). A failed action's ERROR still replays as ERROR (retry_replays_the_original_result).

cases.name: pending_long_action_reports_when_it_completes
cases.description: Result known later, past the budget: ACCEPTED at once, the RESULT as soon as the application completes it (ERROR here), not at the deadline.

cases.name: pending_short_action_answers_when_it_completes
cases.description: Result known later, deadline within the budget: the answer waits and goes as soon as it completes.

cases.name: pending_action_past_its_deadline_is_error
cases.description: No completion by the deadline: ERROR (RESULT); a late completion changes nothing and a query gets ERROR.

cases.name: pending_action_cut_by_a_reboot_is_interrupted
cases.description: A reboot cuts a pending action: INTERRUPTED, its RESULT after boot; the completion that comes after is ignored.

cases.name: pending_instant_action_is_error
cases.description: An instant action (no time) cannot complete later: PENDING there is answered ERROR.
